lesson_title: Equations of Motion: The Absent Character Trick
hook_text: Stop guessing which equation. The problem already chose it for you.
clip_script: Notice what happened as each one was read: the missing character was named. Every equation lacks exactly one of the five quantities — and that missing character is the whole secret of choosing. A problem hands you three quantities and asks for a fourth; the fifth, neither given nor wanted, is the one your equation must not contain. Identify the absent character; take the equation that excludes it. Selected not by luck, not by trial — by the absence of time.
visual_style: Five character cards (vi, vf, a, t, Δx) line up; the unmentioned one greys out and slides off screen, and the one matching equation glows and locks into place.
pacing: Quick five-character setup, dramatic grey-out of the absent one, instant equation payoff.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and solve the 210 m bakkie problem start to finish.
